findings.description: Consumes `records` twice in violation of the one-shot iterator requirement.
findings.evidence: Line 2 computes `total` by iterating `records`, fully exhausting it. Line 3 then iterates `records` again to build the output dict. If `records` is a generator or any single-pass iterator, line 3 will yield no items, resulting in an empty dictionary `{}` instead of the required mapping. The SPEC explicitly states that `records` 'may be a one-shot iterator such as a generator and must be consumed only once.'

review.summary: The function iterates over `records` twice, exhausting one-shot iterators before the dictionary comprehension can process them.
